extracted.name: Banana bread
extracted.description: Simple banana bread for winter nights.
instruction_lines: Smash them banana in a bowl, then add sugar, cooking oil, milk, egg
In another bowl, mix flour and salt and baking soda
Put the flour into the wet mix, then mix well
Put the chocolate chips or raisins in, and mix well
Fill 3/4 of each of the loaf pand with the mix
